verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers a Terraform provider explicitly for version-controlling connection/config as code, plus PyAirbyte and a REST API for programmatic, code-first pipeline definition — enabling repo-based, reviewable workflows outside the GUI. However, the primary documented workflow (Connector Builder, UI-driven sync config) remains no-code/UI-centric, and there's no independent evidence of teams running fully code-first CI/CD pipelines end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of Terraform/PyAirbyte as primary workflow, evidence of PR-review-based pipeline changes, and confirmation that full pipeline definitions (not just connection config) are portable as code.
